**Continuous 2.8.2**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.8.2.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.8.2.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.8.2.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.8.2.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.8.2.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.8.2.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.8.2.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.8.2-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.8.2.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.8.2-vscode/continuous-cli-2.8.2.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.8.1

**A new mark**

- **The Loop mark and the logo are a two-phase infinity.** The left lobe is planning (cyan) and the right is building; each carries a bead of the other's colour, diagonally opposite, like a yin and yang. On the Loop chip the lobe of the current turn is lit and the other dims, replacing the rotating disc; at rest the mark dims and keeps the lobe it last used lit. The extension icon, the activity-bar icon, the favicons and the README banner use the same figure. (#408)

**Toolbar**

- **The five policy chips are narrower and readable.** Each is the area's icon with a small level glyph and a colour instead of three truncated letters: a raised hand for Manual, a shield for Cautious, sparkles for Automatic, an open lock for Permissive, a bolt for YOLO or IDGAF. Green means you decide or your rules check, blue a reviewer, amber rules only, red nothing checks. The level's name is in the tooltip and the accessible label, and each level shows its glyph in the dropdown. (#407)

**Planning**

- Plans for what comes next, not features: budgets per to-do and ways to divide a loop's budget among them, running whole loops in a jail, memory and history ageing, stuck detection, and more. See [`plans/ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/plans/ROADMAP.md). (#408)

## Not included

The JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continuous. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
